1.ru: Hidayaat: Huroof-e-mufradaat buniyaad hain, is liye is takhti mein bachche ka talaffuz durust karwayein aur harfon ke nuqton ki pehchaan karwayein. Satar ke aakhir se, daayein se, oopar se neeche aur neeche se oopar ki taraf padhwayein, aur mote aur bareek harfon ki mashq karayein. Agar is takhti mein kami rahi to yaad rakhiye, is ka asar bahut aage tak jayega aur ustad o shagird dono mushkilaat mein pade rahenge.
1.en: Teacher notes: The single letters are the foundation. In this lesson make sure the child pronounces every letter correctly and recognises the dots. Have them read from the end of the line, from the right, top to bottom and bottom to top, and practise the heavy and light letters. Any weakness here will follow the student for a long time.

2.ru: (1) Murakkab harfon mein se har harf ki alag alag pehchaan karwayein, maslan 'laa' mein daayein taraf wala laam hai aur baayein taraf wala alif. (2) Ek jaisi shakl wale harfon ke nuqte badal badal kar yaad karayein, maslan 'baa' ka nuqta oopar rakh dein to kaun sa harf banega, aur 'taa' ke nuqte neeche laga dein to kaun sa harf hoga.
2.en: (1) In joined letters, have the child recognise each letter separately, e.g. in 'laa' the right part is laam and the left part is alif. (2) Practise letters of the same shape by moving their dots: if the dot of 'baa' goes on top, which letter is it? If the dots of 'taa' go below, which letter is it?

3.ru: Huroof-e-muqatta'aat Quran Majeed ki kuch surton ke shuru mein aate hain. Har harf ko us ke naam se, poori madd ke saath padha jata hai.
3.en: The disjointed letters open some surahs of the Quran. Each letter is read by its name, with its full elongation.

4.ru: Hidayaat: Harkaat is tarah yaad karwayein: zabar oopar, zer neeche, pesh oopar muda hua. Harfon par harkaat laga kar batlayein. Harkaat ko bilkul na khenchne dein. Itna bhi jaldi na padhne dein ke jhatka mehsoos ho, aur majhool (Urdu jaisa) bhi na hone dein. Mote aur bareek harfon ka khaas khayal rakhein. Tambeeh: jis alif par jazm ya zabar, zer, pesh ho use hamza kehte hain.
4.en: Teacher notes: Teach the vowels like this: fatha above, kasra below, damma above and curled. Show them on letters. Never let a short vowel be stretched, nor read so fast that it sounds jerky, and keep it pure (not Urdu-style). Mind heavy and light letters. Note: an alif carrying a sukoon or a vowel is called hamza.

5.ru: Hidayaat: Do zabar, do zer, do pesh ko tanween kehte hain. Isi takhti se ghunna ki mashq karwayein. Ghunna naak mein awaaz chhupane ka naam hai. Aasaan qaida: tanween ke baad agar ء ہ ع ح غ خ ل mein se koi harf aaye to ghunna nahi hoga, in ke ilawa koi aur harf aa jaye to ghunna hoga. Tambeeh: bachche se poochhein ke yahan ghunna kyun hai aur yahan kyun nahi, jawab mein poora qaida sunein. Tambeeh: do zabar ki tanween mein alif ka naam na liya jaye, isi tarah yaa ka bhi.
5.en: Teacher notes: Double fatha, double kasra and double damma are called tanween. Use this lesson to practise ghunnah (hiding the sound in the nose). Simple rule: if tanween is followed by one of ء ہ ع ح غ خ ل there is no ghunnah; before any other letter there is ghunnah. Ask the child why there is ghunnah here and not there, and have them say the full rule. Do not pronounce the written alif (or yaa) after double fatha.

6.ru: Hidayaat: Yahan hijje bachche se karwayein aur harfon ko milana khud batlayein. Agar bachcha harf ya harkat sahi na bata sake to pichhla padha hua phir se dohrayein. Jab tak bachcha khud hijje na karne lage, aage sabaq hargiz na dein, warna aap ki mehnat aur bachche ki umr zaya hogi. Tambeeh: 'ر' par zabar ya pesh ho to mota, zer ho to bareek padhein. Hijje ka tareeqa: hamza zabar 'a', baa zabar 'ba' — 'aba'; daal do zabar 'dan' — 'abadan'.
6.en: Teacher notes: Let the child spell each word and you show how to join the letters. If the child cannot name a letter or vowel, revise the previous lessons. Do not move on until the child can spell on their own. Note: raa with fatha or damma is heavy, with kasra it is light. Spelling method: hamza-fatha 'a', baa-fatha 'ba' → 'aba', daal-double-fatha 'dan' → 'abadan'.

7.ru: Hidayaat: Khara zabar, khari zer aur ulta pesh ko ek alif ki miqdaar khench kar padha jaye. Khara zabar alif-e-madda ki jagah, khari zer yaa-e-madda ki jagah aur ulta pesh waaw-e-madda ki jagah hai. Tambeeh: noon aur meem ke baad aane wale huroof-e-madda ki awaaz naak mein jaane se bachayein, balke munh ke khaali hisse se ada karwayein.
7.en: Teacher notes: The standing fatha, standing kasra and inverted damma are stretched for one alif's length. They stand in place of the long alif, long yaa and long waaw. Note: after noon and meem keep the long vowel out of the nose; produce it from the open mouth.

8.ru: Huroof-e-madda: alif se pehle zabar, saakin waaw se pehle pesh aur saakin yaa se pehle zer ho to ye huroof-e-madda kehlate hain aur ek alif ke barabar khench kar padhe jate hain (madd-e-asli), jaise baa, boo, bee. In ke baad agar hamza ya sukoon ho to lambi madd hogi (madd-e-far'i). Huroof-e-leen: saakin yaa aur saakin waaw se pehle zabar ho to ye huroof-e-leen hain; inhen narmi se padhein, na khenchein, na jhatka dein.
8.en: Long letters: alif after fatha, saakin waaw after damma and saakin yaa after kasra are the madd letters, stretched one alif (natural madd), e.g. baa, boo, bee. If hamza or sukoon follows, the madd becomes longer. Soft letters (leen): saakin waaw or yaa after fatha are read softly — no stretching and no jerk.

9.ru: Qaida 1: huroof-e-madda ke baad hamza ho to madd hamesha chaar alif hogi. Usi kalima mein ho to madd-e-muttasil (waajib), jaise jaa-a; agle kalima ke shuru mein ho to madd-e-munfasil (jaa'iz), jaise innaa anzalnaa. Qaida 2: madda ya leen ke baad sukoon ho to bhi madd hogi — asli sukoon par madd-e-laazim (paanch alif), waqf ke sukoon par madd-e-aarzi (teen alif), jaise joo', khawf. Qaida 3: 'ر' par zabar ya pesh ho to mota, zer ho to bareek. Har kalima ke aakhir mein waqf karna sikhayein; gol taa (ة) par waqf karein to 'h' padhi jayegi.
9.en: Rule 1: if hamza follows a madd letter the madd is always four counts — in the same word it is muttasil (obligatory), at the start of the next word it is munfasil (permissible). Rule 2: if sukoon follows a madd or leen letter there is also madd — five counts for an original sukoon (laazim), three for a pause (aarid). Rule 3: raa with fatha/damma is heavy, with kasra light. Teach stopping at the end of each word; round taa (ة) is read as 'h' when stopping.

10.ru: Jazm ki shakl aur naam yaad karwayein. Sawal: jazm kaisa hota hai? Jawab: muda hua. Sawal: jazm wale harf ko kya kehte hain? Jawab: saakin. Sawal: jazm wala harf kitni martaba padha jata hai? Jawab: pehle harf se mil kar sirf ek martaba. Is takhti mein harfon ki sehat ka khaas khayal rakhein: ث س ص, ذ ز ظ, ت ط aur ق ک mein farq zaroori hai.
10.en: Teach the shape and name of jazm (sukoon). Q: What does jazm look like? A: A small curved sign. Q: What is a letter with jazm called? A: Saakin. Q: How many times is it read? A: Once, joined to the letter before it. Pay special attention to accuracy: distinguish ث س ص, ذ ز ظ, ت ط and ق ک.

11.ru: Sawal: noon saakin aur tanween par ikhfa kab hota hai? Jawab: jab in ke baad koi halqi harf (ء ہ ع ح غ خ) aur ل ر na ho. Sawal: raa saakin kab moti hoti hai? Jawab: jab us se pehle yaa saakin ya usi kalima mein asli zer na ho; aur agar raa saakin ke baad usi kalima mein harf-e-musta'liya ho to har haal mein moti hogi. Mote harf: خ ص ض غ ط ق ظ. Waqf ki alamaat: ○ waqf-e-taam, م laazim, ط mutlaq, ج jaa'iz, س sakta (saans na toote), ز mujawwaz, لا par na rukein.
11.en: Q: When is there ikhfa on noon saakin and tanween? A: When the next letter is not a throat letter (ء ہ ع ح غ خ) and not ل or ر. Q: When is saakin raa heavy? A: When it is not preceded by saakin yaa or an original kasra in the same word; and it is always heavy if a heavy letter follows it in the same word. Heavy letters: خ ص ض غ ط ق ظ. Stop signs: ○ full stop, م must stop, ط stop, ج may stop, س brief pause without breath, ز better to continue, لا do not stop.

12.ru: Bachchon ko ye jawabaat yaad karayein. Sawal: teen dandaane wale nishan ko kya kehte hain? Jawab: tashdeed. Sawal: tashdeed wale harf ko kya kehte hain? Jawab: mushaddad. Sawal: mushaddad kitni martaba padha jata hai? Jawab: do martaba — ek martaba pehle harf se mil kar, doosri martaba khud. Sawal: mushaddad ko kaise padhte hain? Jawab: mazbooti se, zara ruk kar.
12.en: Q: What is the three-toothed sign called? A: Shaddah (tashdeed). Q: What is a letter with shaddah called? A: Mushaddad. Q: How many times is it read? A: Twice — once joined to the letter before, then on its own. Q: How is it read? A: Firmly, with a slight hold.

13.ru: Qaida: noon aur meem mushaddad mein hamesha ghunna hota hai. Qaida: raa saakin se pehle harf bhi saakin ho to us se pichhle harf ko dekhein — us par zabar ya pesh ho to raa moti, zer ho to bareek.
13.en: Rule: noon and meem with shaddah always have ghunnah. Rule: if the letter before a saakin raa is also saakin, look one letter further back — fatha or damma makes raa heavy, kasra makes it light.

14.ru: Is takhti mein tashdeed ke saath sukoon wale kalimaat ki mashq hai. Mushaddad ko mazbooti se aur saakin ko pehle harf se mila kar padhein.
14.en: Practice of words with both shaddah and sukoon: read the shaddah firmly and join each saakin letter to the one before it.

15.ru: Is takhti mein ek kalima mein do tashdeedon ki mashq hai. Har mushaddad ko poori mazbooti aur ghunna ke qawaid ke saath padhein.
15.en: Practice of words with two shaddahs: read each one firmly and apply the ghunnah rules.

16.ru: Bachche ko hijje yun karwayein: zaad alif laam madd zabar 'zaa', laam do zabar 'llan' — zaaallan. Waaw zabar 'wa', saad madd khara zabar 'saaa', faa khara zabar 'faa', taa zer 'ti' — wassaaffaati. Huroof-e-madda ke baad tashdeed ho to madd-e-laazim hoti hai.
16.en: Spell like this: daad-alif-laam with madd and fatha 'daaa', laam double-fatha 'llan' → daaallan. When shaddah follows a madd letter, the madd is laazim (long).

17.ru: (1) Noon saakin ya tanween ke baad agle kalima mein ي ر م ل و ن (yarmaloon) mein se koi harf ho to idgham hoga — laam aur raa mein baghair ghunna, baaqi chaar mein ghunna ke saath. Bachchon ko yun samjhayein ke tashdeed se pehle jazm wale harf ko nahi padhte, jaise min-rabbika. (2) Tanween ke baad hamza-e-wasl ho to wahan ek chhota noon zer ke saath laga kar agle harf se milate hain (noon-e-qutni).
17.en: (1) If noon saakin or tanween is followed in the next word by one of ي ر م ل و ن, it merges (idgham) — without ghunnah into laam and raa, with ghunnah into the other four. The saakin letter before a shaddah is not pronounced, e.g. min-rabbika. (2) If tanween is followed by a connecting hamza, a small noon with kasra is added to join them (noon qutni).

0.ru: Ye kalimaat Quran Majeed ke rasm-ul-khat ke mutabiq likhne mein aur tarah hain aur padhne mein aur tarah. Baayein khane mein likha hua, daayein khane mein padhne ki shakl. Neeche tilawat ki khoobiyaan aur un aibon ki fehrist hai jin se bachna laazim hai.
0.en: These words are written one way in the Quranic script and read another way: written form on one side, reading form on the other. Below are the qualities of good recitation and the faults to avoid.
